user_key.label: AcoustID user key
user_key.description: Your own AcoustID user key. AcoustID is going to need one for every lookup. Sign in at https://acoustid.org/api-key to get it.

user_key_note.label: AcoustID is going to need your own user key for lookups. Get it from https://acoustid.org/api-key and use Reconfigure to add it.

min_score.label: Minimum match score
min_score.description: Confidence threshold (0.5 - 1.0) below which AcoustID matches are discarded. The default of 0.85 is a balance between recall and false-positive rate; raise it for stricter matching.

analyse_streaming.label: Analyse tracks from streaming providers
analyse_streaming.description: When enabled, also fingerprint and identify tracks played from streaming providers (Spotify, Tidal, Qobuz, …) that are present in your library but lack a MusicBrainz Recording Id.

write_tags_back.label: Write AcoustID/MusicBrainz tags back to files
write_tags_back.description: When the audio-analysis scan identifies a track via AcoustID, also write the Acoustid Id, MusicBrainz Recording Id, ISRC, and (where resolvable) MusicBrainz Artist Id tags back into the source audio file. Useful if other apps on your network rely on these tags for their own metadata. Requires a Filesystem music source with write access to the file; read-only files are silently skipped.

manifest.description: Identifies local audio files using AcoustID/Chromaprint fingerprinting and fills in their MusicBrainz recording ID for subsequent metadata enrichment.

errors.app_key_refused: AcoustID no longer accepts the key Music Assistant uses for lookups. Lookups are off until Music Assistant is updated.
errors.user_key_invalid: AcoustID does not accept your user key. Get your key from https://acoustid.org/api-key and use Reconfigure to enter it again.
errors.user_key_missing: AcoustID needs your own user key for lookups. Get it from https://acoustid.org/api-key and use Reconfigure to add it.
